items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday injury report; not expected to play per Rapoport. McVay optimistic for return next week vs Eagles barring setback.
items.why: Hip injury; no practice Friday; McVay and Rap Sheet confirm not expected Sunday.
items.implication: Adams carries primary WR load; elevated routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target/route share spike (prior 42% TPRR sans Nacua).

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Rapoport: good longer-term news, Mariota starts; not IR.
items.why: Official Friday ruling; positive longer-term outlook per Rap Sheet.
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin target share historically ~25% with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Limited for skill players; lowest implied total.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: Off injury report Friday; Coleman ruled out.
items.implication: Committee returns; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey split carries; monitor snap shares.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring. Confirmed OUT on ETR list and Rapoport.
items.implication: Targets redistribute; Schultz saw 28-30% target share last week without him.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz TE target share and Colts D allowing 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says he will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury; official ruling. RB coach: Warren leads, breathers for freshness.
items.implication: Warren lead back; checkdown volume likely with Rodgers vertical struggles.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren lead carries + routes; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Mitchell/DJ Moore.
items.why: Internal projections based on practice/limited info; big DFS implications.
items.implication: Treat as likely active for lineup/DFS; monitor final reports.
items.opportunity: Full roles if cleared; Warren lead, Evans/Bowers volume.

items.text: ETR Sunday list: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne IN (among others like Dobbins/Harvey/Darnold/Price). Questionables include Bowers/Evans/Warren/Flowers/DJ Moore.
items.why: Full ETR parse of Friday/Sunday statuses; Levitan projecting several Qs in.
items.implication: Nabers full go boosts Giants pass game; Etienne role still limited per Berry.
items.opportunity: Confirm snap/route shares; Warren lead if active.

items.text: ETR projections live for Week 3; Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.why: Sim-based ceiling; high opportunity in Lions offense.
items.implication: Elite DFS/tournament upside; start with confidence.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect checkdown spam as Rodgers vertical not working. Projecting Warren (Q) in; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Coach comments + vertical struggles; usage opportunity focus.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with volume + receiving work.
items.opportunity: Lead carries, checkdowns, third-down; high snap share.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup. Etienne also IR note in context.
items.why: Expected IR placement; utilization confirms Hubbard lead.
items.implication: Hubbard every-week starter; clear lead back.
items.opportunity: Hubbard snap/touch monopoly; possible FA signing.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42%. Prior results sans Nacua: strong (e.g. 8-195-2). Projecting Nacua out boosts Adams.
items.why: Route/target rate data when Nacua off field; Rap Sheet notes Adams can carry load.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5, DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Also loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches/15% targets both weeks, PIT soft vs RBs.
items.implication: Strong start candidates; Henry smash, Brown RB1 upside.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV soft vs WRs); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% share sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs); Christian Watson vs ATL (high util, RZ share).
items.why: Target share, aDOT, matchup DvP, utilization.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards/targets; Schultz routes/tgts; Watson RZ.

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches, tough JAX run D); Travis Etienne vs LV (low snap/touch share even with Kamara); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (tough WR D, low team total, Mariota).
items.why: Role/snap declines, tough matchups, QB change.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson gap narrowed but Stevenson still ahead per Berry.
items.opportunity: Monitor Henderson snaps post-fumble; Etienne third-down low.
